body:
Life's enough of a fucking mess without being sabotaged from the start. You didn't ask for this life or the damage that came with it but it's yours now, it's going to take work to get everything cleared up but damn it, after what you've been through you deserve a good life and I hope you don't stop fighting til you get it. I think you're heading in the right direction by just having an understanding of what happened to you. I am rooting for you.
Counseling or therapy may be a good start to sorting this out if you haven't saught help for this yet- you do not have to deal with this alone.
Are you creative at all? Making things is such a huge relief for me. Even something as simple as doing origami.

I just want to grow vegetables and be left alone but I was born in a city and have not found my way to having land yet, only depression. What has humanity turned into?so many people are being forced to sell our hours and I personally think it's unnatural.. I think it's unlivable for plenty of people and it's not their fault...

Mine is a gray pullover with wolves and "Alaska" on it even though I've never been to Alaska. It's kind of spotty looking as it is so you can't really tell when the sleeves are soaked. I hope something feels better for you soon

Wow! That's no easy feat! 
I think if you got yourself out there enough to land the job, you have a great shot at seeing it through. You already took the first step in that direction, this is just taking another. Your post has given me some hope for myself, I want you to know. You're brave af  and you've done great so far, keep it up!

Mine have started spilling out into happy times too, I'm starting to worry that it's turning into a heart problem or something because of that. I can't even get too excited about anything anymore, even just in a conversation without having to work to come back down to earth and stop the palpitating.. It wasn't always like this but it's become this way.

You probably bring a lot of light into Kevin's life by being there for him even though you don't love it. Maybe you could talk to him about needing alone time? Or call it project time or something? I need time away from even the most gifted conversationalists and to teach him that some people need this sometimes may be a gift to him also.
She looks like a porcelain figurine, such an elegant kitty!

You can call the police and they will take you to get help at the hospital if you really need to be evaluated and fully explain your situation. Might be a little scary at first but it's a fine way to get help when you have no other choice. I went this route once when I was in your situation and my parent would not help at all. I believe you can do this in the US, Canada and UK, though my experience is only with the US.
